Stonecairn’s 2025 budget per resident:

2,884.6 million tenge ÷ 14,926 residents  
= 2,884,600,000 ÷ 14,926  
≈ 193,284.70 tenge per resident

Coldharbour’s 2025 budget per resident:

2,366.9 million tenge ÷ 11,407 residents  
= 2,366,900,000 ÷ 11,407  
≈ 207,517.31 tenge per resident

Difference:

207,517.31 − 193,284.70 = 14,232.61 tenge per resident

Coldharbour had the larger budget per resident by approximately 14,233 tenge per resident.

ANSWER: Coldharbour | 14233
